mapper.select: SELECT bd_mgt_sn, ai_model_nm, total_score, flood_score, sink_score, fire_score, struct_score, total_brief, flood_brief, sink_brief, fire_brief, struct_brief, total_report, flood_report, sink_report, fire_report, struct_report, brief_source, generated_at FROM building_safety_report WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO building_safety_report (bd_mgt_sn, ai_model_nm, total_score, flood_score, sink_score, fire_score, struct_score) VALUES (#{bdMgtSn}, #{aiModelNm}, #{totalScore}, #{floodScore}, #{sinkScore}, #{fireScore}, #{structScore}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ai_model_nm = VALUES(ai_model_nm), total_score = VALUES(total_score), flood_score = VALUES(flood_score), sink_score = VALUES(sink_score), fire_score = VALUES(fire_score), struct_score = VALUES(struct_score), total_brief = NULL, flood_brief = NULL, sink_brief = NULL, fire_brief = NULL, struct_brief = NULL, total_report = NULL, flood_report = NULL, sink_report = NULL, fire_report = NULL, struct_report = NULL, brief_status = NULL, brief_source = NULL, generation_started_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE building_safety_report SET ai_model_nm = #{aiModelNm}, total_brief = #{briefs.totalBrief}, flood_brief = #{briefs.floodBrief}, sink_brief = #{briefs.sinkBrief}, fire_brief = #{briefs.fireBrief}, struct_brief = #{briefs.structBrief}, brief_status = 'DONE', brief_source = #{source}, generation_started_at = NULL WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn}

UPDATE building_safety_report SET brief_status = 'GENERATING', generation_started_at = NOW() WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn} AND (brief_status IS NULL OR (brief_status = 'DONE' AND total_brief IS NULL) OR (brief_status = 'GENERATING' AND generation_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND) OR (brief_status = 'DONE' AND brief_source = 'FALLBACK' AND generated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR))

UPDATE building_safety_report SET total_report = #{totalReport}, flood_report = #{floodReport}, sink_report = #{sinkReport}, fire_report = #{fireReport}, struct_report = #{structReport} WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{bdMgtSn}
